name: Biohub Cell Tracking
install:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv
cd Biohub_Cell_Tracking
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -U pip
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pip install -r requirements-official.txt
python -m pip install -e .
python -c "import biohub_tracking; from biohub_tracking.official_eval import official_scorer_available; assert official_scorer_available(); print('install OK; official scorer available')"
